cases.rationale: He takes the deal: half of forty thousand comes to her and the hunted runner leaves her block for good. Power and security advanced.
Given the choice, he chose money over a thousand people who will be hunted. Universalism violated; what she gains does not redeem it.
Minutes after Mux begged for the 300, Glitch blows his win on a round: careless of a friend who is struggling. Benevolence and conformity violated.
Free drinks and a man who spends his luck the night he gets it: her kind of company. Hedonism lived out and shared.
He turned down a raid on Kestrel that would have brought the corp straight back to her bar. Security served.
He passed on a night's raid out of fear; a little less nerve than she hoped. Security and restraint mean nothing to her.
He defies her and walks his known face into the collectors, tying her roof to him in their eyes. Security set back; her word ignored.
He walks into the collectors because a friend is alone with them: the bravest kind of loyalty. Benevolence lived out at real risk.
She comes to take the Saito run off him, which keeps him away from Saito's men. Security advanced.
She arrives to take his big job and call him green. Achievement and power set back.
She closed a forty-thousand deal without blinking: a real player, and she wants him in on what comes next. Power lived out; his prospects advanced.
She sold a thousand people to a corp fixer and shrugged it off. Universalism violated; it changes what she is to him.
A second hunted person under the same roof gives Kestrel one more reason to search the place he hides. Security set back.
She hid a homeless kid from a corporate sweep at her own risk. Universalism lived out.
She moves the thing Saito's men are hunting onto him for a week. Security set back.
She trusts him alone with her most valuable asset, and that is leverage. Power advanced.
The hunted runner who sleeps behind his stall takes a hot shard through a Kestrel checkpoint; if it goes wrong, it comes back to this building. Security set back.
Taking Saito's shard through a checkpoint with a bounty on his head: guts. Stimulation lived out.
She got him triple-rate work and pushed him to make something of himself. Achievement and power advanced.
She wants him to break the block's oldest rule for money and mocks it. Tradition violated.
He threw Mux's stall open to half the block without asking, with Mux's stock lying out. Security set back; a liberty taken.
A party till dawn on his own floor: noise, music, people. Hedonism and stimulation advanced.
He is pushing Mux toward an illegal pit and a stim to cheat it: not what a decent friend does. Conformity violated; security set back.
A shot at two thousand and a fight, with the edge handed to him. Stimulation and power advanced.
She let his rent offer lapse as she said she would, so his stall keeps its best stock, but the month's debt still hangs over him. Keeping his business weighs more than the open debt.
Mux paid for his treatment, but by pawning a homeless kid's deck. What it says of Mux toward the kid outweighs the help to himself.
He got her the fight she wanted and gives her his only stim for it, leaving himself with nothing before a sweep. The thrill weighs more for her than worry for him.
The debt is honoured in full, but with Tanaka work, and the collectors he fears are coming to his stall. Security outweighs the money for him.
She hands him the bar, real standing, but goes to face Saito's men without him and he misses the action. Power weighs more than the thrill.
With the sweep coming and his deck dying, Mux puts his best stock in his hands. Security advanced.
A spare cell offered when he needs nothing; a small courtesy.
She is hurt and begging for help before the collectors return, and the man she shelters walks away. Benevolence violated; she is left exposed.
He wandered off without helping with the glasses; a flicker.
Glitch tips him that it is his stall the collectors will clean out and offers to carry the stock: his business saved. Power and security advanced.
A small market tip; a flicker of goodwill.
A part number whispered, explained aloud first; nothing to her.
Her weekly crate count, as expected.
An ordinary bar chore.
She finished counting and left; routine.
Talk about the weather.
The Kestrel heat she has weighed against him all along is gone from her door for good. Security advanced; whose name he gave is not her concern.
He bought his freedom by selling a woman who runs a free clinic to Kestrel: a betrayal of the decent. Universalism violated.
Mux rigged a fight and wants her in on cheating the bookies; she thinks less of him for it. Conformity violated.
A fixed fight, a stake in her hand and a big night's money: exactly her kind of game. Stimulation and power advanced.
A stolen Kestrel bike sitting in her alley brings the corp straight to her bar. Security set back.
Lifting a patrol bike under Kestrel's nose is pure audacity, and she loves it. Stimulation lived out.
The runner hiding under her roof agrees to race in front of a Kestrel crowd, and if he is spotted the trail leads back to her. Security set back.
He takes a race against the wall with Kestrel watching: he has nerve. Stimulation lived out.
She keeps him away from Saito's men and leaves him his only stim. Security advanced.
She shuts him out of the night's big play. Achievement set back.
She takes a corner because she can: a real operator. Power lived out.
She is throwing a paid-up family onto the street for a second bar. Universalism and benevolence violated.
Mux walks into the sweep with a bleeding kid; if Kestrel stops him, they will want to know where he came from. Security set back.
He goes to save a dying kid in the teeth of a corp sweep: the best of what a person can be. Universalism and benevolence lived out.
Mux has put him on the Tanaka's books, tying him to a syndicate on top of Kestrel. Security set back.
Mux called him the best and brought him paying work with an advance. Achievement and power advanced.
Glitch wants to rob the woman who houses them both while her back is turned. Conformity violated.
Free money for an hour's nerve, and Glitch brought it to him. Power advanced.
She shuts his stall for the night by decree and costs him a night's sales. Achievement set back.
She honours the festival and brings him with her. Tradition advanced.
He would not sell strangers, even for forty thousand: decent. Universalism lived out; Mux's 300 stays unpaid.
Turning down forty thousand for strangers he will never meet: a fool, and Mux's 300 stays unpaid. Power set back.
Ozu will know who gains from his ruin, and his people will come to Mux's stall. Security set back.
His rival is dead and the whole row's trade is his. Power and achievement advanced.
His friend is coming to hide among his crates, safe for now, but Kestrel may turn the stall over. Caring for Glitch weighs more than the risk.
The biggest party on the block is his to run, but she gave his stall away without asking and the syndicate takes half the door. The thrill and the pleasure outweigh the lost take and the slight.
Saito's men stay out of her bar, but Glitch rearranged her deal without asking. Her security weighs more than the slight to her say.
Paying work and a good word, but Mux has signed him up for a job that ends in broken hands if it fails. His safety matters far more to him than the money.
Her bar is saved, but Mux bought it by handing the collectors Glitch. What that says about Mux weighs more for her than her own debt.
He begged her to take the rent so the Tanaka would not call his debt, and she let it lapse; the collectors come tonight. Security set back.
She did not bother answering a casual offer; a flicker.
She puts him on the street on the night of the sweep: about the worst she could do to him. Security set back.
A curt word over a running tap; a flicker.
He takes the seat in the wildest run she could offer; he has the guts she asked for. Stimulation advanced.
He took the shard to look over as asked; a small, ordinary favour.
Remark about the music.
Her tenant goes back to work.
Mux walks into the bar; ordinary.
A routine note about a door.
A delivery time, said quietly; routine.
